description: World/initialization seed-range registry (half-open [lo, hi)). Every new extended-05 range must be disjoint from every other entry; asserted by research/tools/campaign05_hr.py (check_seed_ranges) and tests/test_campaign05_hr.py. Sources: extended-03/04 configs (configs/campaign03, configs/campaign04), research/tools/campaign04_a1_configs.py EXT03_RANGES, campaign04_c_configs.py OTHER_RANGES/ranges(), extended-04 protocols (F3 200M, A3 190M) and probeworld tools.

ranges.name: ext03 training (boot 3.0e9+, rl 3.4e9+; ext04 f-boot r3-r5 3.06/3.08/3.10e9; A2/A3 training 3.44e9)
ext04 probeworld training 8e9 (8e9 + 1e8*seed, seeds 0-5 incl. own-world offset)
ext05 A-HR states/branches 220M (+100,000*i; i=0 iid_f0, 1 iid_f2; same worlds for every base)
ext05 A-HR reserve 230M (originally the online oracle policy, dropped in design v2; reserved for the G1-fail bounded multi-step option test)
ext05 probeworld split table v2 (b5_*, b5x_train) 5.1e9-5.8e9: configs base + i, eval worlds base + 5e7 + 1000 i + r (i < 4000)
ext05 B-XC b5c_hold_uc 5.9e9: configs 5.9e9 + i, eval worlds 5.9e9 + 5e7 + 1000 i + r (i < 4000; offset 900)
ext05 probeworld training worlds B-X/B-Q seeds 10-12 (8e9 + 1e8*seed)
ext05 probeworld training worlds B-XC seeds 20-22 (8e9 + 1e8*seed)
